title: Mobile App, UI Interaction by @SebJVidal: Little component I whipped up for an upcoming feature of @one_sec_app.
notes:
Little component I whipped up for an upcoming feature of @one_sec_app. An infinitely scrollable collection view displaying polaroids of the very talented folks working on the app (and me) Ended up using a custom collection view layout. Compositional layout got me 90% of the way there, but needed a little more control. Detail view is a custom view controller transition – the polaroid flip animation is courtesy of CATransform3D.

Designer: @SebJVidal. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
